sloka: कथां कथयतां तेषां जयं चाकाङ्क्षतां शुभम् ।व्यतीता रजनी शीघ्रं शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.६८.१ ॥
transliteration: kathāṁ kathayatāṁ teṣāṁ jayaṁ cākāṅkṣatāṁ śubham ।vyatītā rajanī śīghraṁ śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.68.1 ॥

translations.english: While they were conversing and wishing for an auspicious victory, the night quickly passed for the great-souled Shatrughna.
